subcategory_text: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-09, PM-18, PM-28, PM-30, RA-03
implementation_examples: Establish criteria for using a quantitative approach to cybersecurity risk analysis, and specify probability and exposure formulas
Create and use templates (e.g., a risk register) to document cybersecurity risk information (e.g., risk description, exposure, treatment, and ownership)
Establish criteria for risk prioritization at the appropriate levels within the enterprise
Use a consistent list of risk categories to support integrating, aggregating, and comparing cybersecurity risks
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated.
Determine whether activities are conducted to establish criteria for using a quantitative approach to cybersecurity risk analysis, and specify probability and exposure formulas.
Determine whether activities are conducted to create and use templates (e.g., a risk register) to document cybersecurity risk information (e.g., risk description, exposure, treatment, and ownership).
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
